major_event: eToro launched its dedicated staking service on 1 October 2020 with Cardano and TRON rewards, later expanding the program to additional proof-of-stake assets and jurisdictions.

duplicate_check.notes: Ordinary repository search returned no eToro Staking record but is not authoritative. Hardened candidate scanning against the full canonical corpus is required before promotion.

notes: First-party material supports an exact dedicated staking-service launch on 2020-10-01 with ADA and TRX. Current first-party staking material states that staked cryptoassets remain the users' property and describes monthly network-derived rewards, jurisdiction-specific eligibility, intro periods, eToro-retained reward shares, liquidity/slashing/network/regulatory risks and a broader current asset set. CYA should preserve the express customer-property language without treating it as a guarantee against validator, platform, custody or insolvency risk, and should keep entity/jurisdiction differences explicit.

major_event: Robinhood Crypto launched its first-ever crypto staking product for European customers on 15 May 2024 with Solana, expanded to Ethereum in Europe in November 2024, and launched staking for eligible U.S. customers in June 2025.

duplicate_check.notes: Ordinary repository search returned no Robinhood Crypto Staking record but is not authoritative. Hardened candidate scanning against the full canonical corpus is required before promotion.

notes: First-party material identifies 2024-05-15 as Robinhood Crypto's first-ever staking launch, initially SOL for Europe. Current U.S. help material supports ETH, SOL and ADA staking, network-derived variable rewards, bonding/unbonding restrictions, slashing risk, third-party staking partner fees and Robinhood Crypto fees. The 2024 Europe launch states customers own their crypto while Robinhood holds it on their behalf, but current service spans different legal entities and jurisdictions, so CYA should not generalize one ownership/insolvency conclusion across all Robinhood staking without applicable terms.
